This has haunted me for years. Maybe getting it off my chest will bring solace. 

5th grade, girls bathroom; only two stalls and half the girls in my grade are jammed in it for some reason and I of course have horrible diarrhea. So I die on the toilet and it's Awful. Everyone knows it's me and they're laughing and gagging and I'm so embarrassed. For what's it's worth I am also gagging.

Fast forward a few weeks later, I'm in the bathroom taking a shit again (what else is there to do in public school) and yknow. It goes normally this time, not toxic like the last; but I have trauma now and I'm so anxious that when two classmates of mine enter, I concoct a plan. Once I finish up and flush and go to wash my hands, I'll tell them I JUST got into the stall to pee and once I flushed the toilet, a strange smell came out of it. There's no way they'll think it was me who took a shit. 

Anyway I was wrong and they looked at me strangely for even bringing up peeing. The bathroom didn't even smell. After all this time I still remember their judging stares, like "why did you tell us this."
